0022600122.text: The Miami Heat (0-3) host the Dallas Mavericks (1-2) in Miami's fourth game of the season, with the Heat on a three-game losing streak and 15th in the East. Dallas, 12th in the West, will be without Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Naji Marshall (illness), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, with Dallas winning the last meeting 118-108 in Dallas on December 3, 2025, and they have not yet played each other this season.
